protocol.scope: Selected five-coordinate recipe and every leave-one-out: full steering on earlier prompt positions (prefill_scale=1), first eight answer-prediction positions starting at last prompt token, then zero direct steering; reapplied every turn with actual generated history retained. Fallback: all positions every turn. Baseline: no intervention.
